limitations: Controlled local login/phishing-like fixtures are not an independently verified phishing benchmark. Stability is not detection accuracy, and a stable prediction can itself be uninformative.
Only three source pages, with correlated variants and two settings per family; descriptive results do not establish statistical significance or global model superiority.
Phase 10 observations are reused exactly; no recollection or variant editing. Their browser/checkpoint constraints and structural-contract equivalence limitations remain.

Zero aggregate delta does not imply an unchanged DOM. M06 replacement witnesses and observed temporal signals are reported independently; adding a mutation script can alter other features relative to an original.
The experiment describes paired probability/label changes of frozen models under this local corpus. It does not demonstrate real-world phishing accuracy, successful attacks or causal generalization.
figure_format: SVG; generated from unchanged predictions without new packages
